supports: Limits on corporate price increases for medicine and food
positions.quote: Congresswoman Ocasio-Cortez is fighting to create a more just economy: one in which workers share in the profits their work creates, and corporations cannot endlessly drive up prices of critical goods like medicine and food.

source.title: Economy | Representative Ocasio-Cortez (official U.S. House website)

positions.impact: Expect support for anti-price-gouging and worker-ownership measures. As one of 435 House members, they would vote and push for this in Congress; it would only become law with majorities in both chambers and the President's signature.

supports: Health care as a human right
positions.quote: Healthcare should be a human right, not a privilege for the wealthy.

source.title: Healthcare | Representative Ocasio-Cortez (official U.S. House website)

positions.impact: She would vote to expand public coverage toward universal health care. As one of 435 House members, they would vote and push for this in Congress; it would only become law with majorities in both chambers and the President's signature.

supports: A minimum tax on large corporations
A $35 monthly cap on insulin costs
positions.quote: Last year, she helped pass the Inflation Reduction Act, which institutes a 15% minimum tax rate on wealthy corporations that have long-avoided paying any taxes at all, and caps the cost of insulin at $35 each month.

source.title: Economy | Representative Ocasio-Cortez (official U.S. House website)

positions.impact: These provisions are already law: large corporations pay at least a 15% minimum tax, and insulin costs for Medicare patients are capped. She would vote to keep or expand them.
